_comment: Declarative spec for this agent's Scaleway Serverless Job definition.
Replaces the old PaaS Blueprint file that needed a manual dashboard
step to apply (no reliable API/CLI for that on the old host). Serverless
Jobs ARE fully API-driven via scripts/scaleway/jobs.mjs
(ensureJobDefinition/setSchedule), so /deploy can create and update this
Job automatically on every deploy, exactly like it already does for the
migration Job - no manual dashboard step.
/deploy should, for each apps/*/job-definition.json found in the repo:
1. Read this file.
2. Call ensureJobDefinition({ ...this file, imageUri: <the just-built
and pushed image tag for this app's registry image> }).
3. If triggerMode === 'cron', call setSchedule(definition.id,
{ cron: cronSchedule, timezone: cronTimezone }).
4. If triggerMode === 'manual', call setSchedule(definition.id,
{ cron: manualPollCron, timezone: 'Europe/Paris' }) - the short
interval queue-check tick documented in entry.ts.
5. If triggerMode === 'continuous', call setSchedule(definition.id,
{ cron: continuousRestartCron, timezone: 'Europe/Paris' }) - the
once-a-day restart safety net documented in entry.ts.
{{AGENT_NAME}} / {{AGENT_TRIGGER_MODE}} / {{AGENT_CRON_SCHEDULE}} are
substituted by setup-agent.mjs at scaffold time.
name: {{AGENT_NAME}}
